title: Shifted Gaussian density bound
statement: For every real $t\ge 1$, the standard Gaussian density satisfies $e^{-3/2}\,\varphi(t)\le \varphi(t+1/t)$, where $\varphi$ denotes the density of a Gaussian with mean $0$ and variance $1$.
